question.text: Unless disclosed in the offer document, what is the maximum percentage of net assets a mutual fund can invest in real estate in a single city under all its REMF schemes?

explanation.text: The Logic: Unless otherwise disclosed in the offer document, no mutual fund shall invest more than 30% of its net assets in a single city under all its real estate mutual fund schemes. The Trap: 15% is the limit for a single real estate project, and 25% is the cap on unlisted company capital. Note: Three contrasting concentration limits on the same page: 30% single city, 15% single project, 25% unlisted company capital.
